title: Title: Executive Assistant & Operations Lead: Property Management & Hospitality (STR/LTR)
description:
Can you take a problem you've never seen before and figure out how to solve it? That's the person we're looking for.



We manage luxury short-term rentals in Tennessee and a long-term rental portfolio in Minnesota, and we're growing. We need a resourceful, organized operator to take ownership of day-to-day operations: someone who thinks a step ahead, closes the loop, and makes sure work moves from "reported" to "done" without being chased.



We care more about how you think than about your exact job history. Some of our best people have come from executive assistant, operations, and hospitality backgrounds, not just property management. If you're sharp, organized, and a fast learner, we'll teach you our systems. We are not looking for a simple task-doer; we want someone who can be given a problem, think through the steps needed to solve it, and come back with the resources and solutions to do so.



What we value:



Solutions over problems:  we don't dwell, we find the fix, and we improve our systems as we go.

Positive, can-do energy:  pipes burst and tenants stop paying; we meet the surprises with a level head and open, honest communication.

A relationship, not a transaction:  a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to d
.

Impact over activity: you won't be micromanaged; you'll get clear goals, the freedom to execute, and the support to succeed.



What you'd own:



Operations (60%): tenant and guest communication, coordinating repairs and vendors, lease renewals and compliance, rent tracking and follow-up, move-in/move-out, and keeping everything moving in 
.

Systems and finance (20%): supporting the build of new systems and initiatives, as well as handling invoices, expense tracking, owner statements, and working within our financial SOPs.

Communication (20%): warm, calm, and professional with guests, tenants, and contractors.



You'll thrive here if you're proactive and detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions without being micromanaged, hungry to learn, and looking for a long-term partnership rather than a transaction.

Must have: reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and comfort working US hours.

How to apply:  please read, this part matters:

We care far more about how you think and communicate than how well you (or an AI) can write a cover letter. So instead of a long written application:

1. Record a short video (60–90 seconds). Any phone or screen recording works (Loom is free). Tell us:



Who you are and why this role fits you. briefly, and,

One real story: a time you solved a problem — a tenant, guest, vendor, or process issue — without waiting for someone to tell you how. What was the situation, and what did you do?



Speak naturally. We don't want a polished script; we want to hear how you actually think.

2. In your written message back to us, please:



Confirm you're available for the schedule: Sun/Mon 9–5, Tue–Thu 9am–1pm US Eastern

Tell us which bookkeeping / PM software you've actually used (QuickBooks, Xero, OwnerRez, REIhub, etc.)

Put the name of the bassist for the Grateful Dead in your message subject so we know you read this far

Share a link to your resume.



That's it. No essays. We review the videos and reach out to the strongest fits fast.

title: Xero Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant (Full Time)
description:
Company: Kingfisher Ads, a US-based advertising agency specializing in Google and Meta ads for the golf industry



About us



We run paid advertising for golf brands, courses, and clubs across the US. Small team, direct communication, no corporate fluff. We move fast and we automate anything worth automating.



The core role



Your foundation is bookkeeping and financial admin:



- Monthly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero

- Sending a small number of invoices manually each month and managing client billing prep, including pulling ad spend figures from Google and Meta to calculate fees

- Completing our monthly cash flow tracking spreadsheet, which tracks all income and expenses by category

- Helping move clients onto automated payments (ACH)

- Producing a short monthly financial summary: revenue by client, spending trends, anything we should look at

- Making recommendations. If you see a better way to categorize, track, or manage our finances, we want to hear it



You should have real experience doing bookkeeping for US-based businesses. You don't need tax expertise, our CPA handles that, but you should be comfortable with US bookkeeping conventions.



Where the role grows



This is not just a bookkeeping job. As you settle in, you'll take on more of our operations:



- Building and running client onboarding checklists in ClickUp

- Screening job applicants against our criteria before they reach us

- Maintaining our content creator database: logging applicants, updating rates, tracking availability

- Prospect list building and CRM upkeep for our outreach efforts

- Tracking our software subscriptions and flagging waste

- Contractor payment admin as our freelance team grows



The automation angle



We use AI tools and automation heavily and we're building more. Repetitive tasks in this role will get automated over time, with your help. Your job evolves as that happens: you maintain the automations, handle the exceptions, and pick up the next manual thing. If you'd rather do the same task the same way forever, this isn't the right fit. If you're the person who asks "why are we still doing this by hand?" you'll do well here.



Requirements



- 2+ years of bookkeeping experience with Xero

- Experience working with US-based businesses

- Strong written English

- Detail-obsessed. Reconciliations that are almost right are wrong

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Own computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available for a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time (most of the work is flexible)



Nice to have



- ClickUp experience

- Experience with Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your daily work

- Agency or marketing industry exposure



Pay



Includes 13th month pay. Full time, long-term role. Salary as listed, paid monthly.



Hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will do a short video interview followed by a paid test task. We respect your time and won't ask for free work.



How to apply



Start your application with the word KINGFISHER so we know you read this post.



Then answer these two questions. Applications without answers to both will not be considered:



1. Describe a repetitive task you automated in a previous role. What tool did you use and what was the result?

2. What's a common mistake you see in how small businesses track cash flow?



Include your Xero experience and the types of US businesses you've done bookkeeping for.

We are a London-based chess school teaching UK children in 1-to-1 online classes, and we are expanding our tutor team.

Our students are in the UK. Our peak teaching times are

). FIDE titles (CM/WCM/FM/WFM) and FIDE Instructor certification are a strong plus

• Consistency: children learn best with the same tutor at the same time each week, so we need you to hold a stable weekly schedule. We cannot accommodate ongoing recurring unavailability, such as monthly tournaments. Planned time off is fully supported — up to 40 working days per year, with at least two weeks' notice

• Reliable internet (10 Mbps+ stable), webcam, headset, and a quiet space



What we offer



• Stable USD income, paid monthly via Stripe

• Recurring, long-term students — families subscribe on a monthly basis and their child stays with the same tutor week after week

title: Outbound B2B Appointment Setter – Cold Calling Australian Businesses (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
THIS IS A PHONE-BASED OUTBOUND SALES ROLE. Most of your hours will be spent making live cold calls to Australian businesses. If you are looking for admin, inbox or data-entry VA work, this is not the role for you.



ABOUT US

Talent Mining & Minerals (TMM) is a Western Australian labour hire company. We supply site-ready workers to mining villages, camp service providers, civil contractors and remote operations across WA: cleaners, kitchen hands, chefs, housekeepers, utility workers, site support staff and FIFO/remote site roles.



THE ROLE

You will not be recruiting candidates. Your job is to get decision makers on the phone, introduce TMM, qualify whether they use backup or overflow labour hire, and book meetings for the owner. The pitch is low-pressure: we are not trying to replace anyone's current suppliers. We position TMM as the reliable backup option when a client needs workers at short notice. These conversations are friendlier than a hard sell, but you still need to get past gatekeepers, handle knock-backs and keep dialling.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make outbound cold calls to Australian businesses: mining village operators, camp service providers, facilities management, civil contractors and remote site operations

- Get past gatekeepers and reach the right decision maker: operations managers, procurement, HR, village managers, workforce coordinators and business owners

- Introduce TMM and position us as a backup / overflow labour option, not a replacement for their current suppliers

- Qualify prospects: do they use labour hire, who supplies them now, where do the gaps appear, who d

- Book qualified meetings directly into the owner's calendar

- Keep clean call notes and update the call sheet or CRM after every call

- Follow up persistently. Most meetings are booked on the second or third touch

- Report weekly on dials, conversations, decision makers reached and meetings booked



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, professional accent that Australian businesses will easily understand on the phone

- Proven B2B cold calling or outbound phone sales experience. This is not an entry-level or admin role

- Comfortable calling Australian (or UK/US/NZ) businesses and speaking with senior people

- Resilient with rejection. You can take 20 knock-backs and make the next call sound like the first

- Confident, natural phone manner. You sound like a person, not a script

- Sales mindset: you measure yourself on meetings booked, not hours logged

- Active LinkedIn profile (include the link in your application)

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet, quality headset and a backup plan for power and internet outages

- Available to work Western Australia business hours (AWST, UTC+8 – the same time zone as the Philippines, so no night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

Experience selling or setting appointments in recruitment, labour hire, staffing, construction, mining, industrial services, outsourcing/BPO, SaaS, finance, insurance or other B2B services. CRM and dialler experience valued.



PAY AND HOURS

- Part-time to start: 15 to 25 hours per week, with room to grow as results come in

- Western Australia business hours (same as Manila time)

- AUD $10 to $18 per hour depending on experience



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be considered. This is the first test of whether you follow a process.

1. A short cover note (max 150 words): who you have cold called before, what you were selling, and your best result

2. Your LinkedIn profile link

3. A 60-second voice recording (instructions below). Applications without a recording will not be reviewed

4. Your written answer to the call opener scenario below

5. Your available hours and your expected hourly rate in AUD



VOICE RECORDING (60 SECONDS, REQUIRED)

Go to 
 and record yourself as if you are live on a call, then paste the share link in your application. The scenario: you have just been put through to the Operations Manager of a mining village services company in Western Australia. Introduce yourself as calling from Talent Mining & Minerals, explain in plain language that TMM provides backup and overflow labour (cleaners, kitchen hands, chefs, housekeepers and site support staff at short notice), and ask one good qualifying question about how they currently handle staffing gaps. Speak naturally. Do not read word-for-word off a script. We want to hear how you actually sound on the phone.



CALL OPENER SCENARIO (ANSWER IN WRITING)

You call a camp services company. The receptionist answers: "He's busy. What's this about?" Write, word for word, what you would say next (3 to 5 sentences max). Your goal: get put through, or come away with the decision maker's name and the best time to call back.



PAID TRIAL

Shortlisted candidates get a paid 2-hour live calling trial at the agreed hourly rate. We provide a short brief on TMM, a one-page pitch outline and 15 to 20 real Australian prospects. We assess how you open, how you handle gatekeepers, how you respond to "not interested", and whether you identify or reach the right decision maker. Booking a meeting during the trial is a bonus, not a requirement.

title: EXPERIENCED VIRTUAL MEDICAL OFFICE ASSISTANT
description:
Gravity Psychiatry & Wellness, PLLC is a growing outpatient psychiatric practice based in Illinois, USA. We provide psychiatric medication management, Spravato® treatment, and related services to children, adolescents, and adults through in-person and telehealth appointments.



The practice is independently owned and led by a board-certified psychiatric-mental health nurse practitioner. This is our first dedicated administrative hire and is intended to be a stable, long-term position.



POSITION SUMMARY



We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Office Assistant to manage the core front-office operations of the practice.



You will report directly to the practice owner and handle patient communication, scheduling, appointment preparation, insurance verification, records, payments, and administrative follow-up. You will also help document and improve workflows by turning recorded task demonstrations and instructions into clear standard operating procedures.



This position is best suited for someone who has already supported a US medical practice, communicates professionally with patients, and can work accurately and independently without constant supervision.



Strong performance may lead to increased responsibilities, additional hours, and advancement toward a Practice Coordinator role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Patient Communication and Scheduling



• Answer incoming patient calls during scheduled coverage hours using the practice’s secure phone system.



• Respond to administrative messages, voi
s, and faxes through Spruce, our HIPAA-compliant communication platform.



• Communicate professionally with adult patients and with parents or guardians of minor patients.



• Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel appointments in Osmind, our electronic health record system.



• Maintain an accurate provider calendar and help fill openings created by cancellations.



• Provide patients with administrative information regarding appointments, forms, office procedures, and practice policies.



• Screen, document, and route messages according to written protocols.



• Promptly escalate messages involving safety concerns, medication questions, worsening symptoms, possible adverse effects, or requests for clinical guidance.



This is an administrative position. The assistant will not provide medical advice, interpret symptoms, recommend treatment, or independently make clinical decisions.



Appointment and Visit Preparation



• Review upcoming appointments for completed intake forms, identification, insurance information, payment information, screening questionnaires, and other required documentation.



• Complete pre-visit administrative check-in procedures.



• Confirm telehealth instructions and appointment details.



• Review copays and outstanding balances before appointments.



• Complete the administrative portions of the Spravato pre-treatment checklist.



• Review overnight messages and same-day cancellations at the beginning of each shift.



• Prepare the next business day’s preliminary schedule before the end of each shift.



• Update the current day’s schedule before the provider’s first appointment.



• Notify the provider of missing documentation, scheduling conflicts, urgent administrative issues, or patient concerns requiring review.



Insurance and Billing Support



• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois, Cigna/Evernorth, Aetna, and other assigned payers.



• Document deductibles, copays, coinsurance, behavioral-health benefits, and authorization requirements accurately.



• Submit and track administrative components of prior-authorization requests, including Spravato authorizations.



• Contact payer portals, insurance companies, pharmacies, and medical offices to obtain claim or authorization status information.



• Follow up on unpaid or denied claims, identify payer requests or denial reasons, and document all actions taken.



• Escalate coding questions, clinical documentation requests, appeals, refunds, adjustments, and other matters requiring provider or billing-specialist review.



• Maintain accurate insurance, authorization, and claim-follow-up trackers.



• Process patient-authorized card-on-file payments according to written practice policy.



• Issue receipts and document payments accurately.



The assistant may not independently change fees, waive balances, establish payment arrangements, issue refunds, modify claim coding, adjust account balances, or make collection exceptions without approval from the practice owner.



Records and Practice Administration



• Process medical-record requests, referrals, releases of information, and incoming and outgoing faxes.



• Confirm that appropriate authorization is present before releasing protected health information.



• Keep patient contact, demographic, pharmacy, insurance, and guarantor information current in the EHR.



• Upload, label, route, and organize documents accurately.



• Maintain administrative trackers for referrals, records requests, authorizations, forms, and assigned follow-up tasks.



• Draft standard operating procedures from recorded task walkthroughs and written instructions.



• Revise procedures based on feedback from the practice owner.



• Assist with administrative audits, data-quality reviews, and workflow testing.



• Support a possible future EHR migration from Osmind to CharmHealth.



FIRST 90 DAYS



During the first 90 days, the primary focus will be:



• Patient communication



• Scheduling and cancellation management



• Appointment readiness



• Intake-document tracking



• Insurance verification



• Records and fax processing



• Payment collection



• Documentation of core workflows



More complex responsibilities, including prior authorizations, denied-claim follow-up, reconciliation support, testing logistics, and special projects, will be added as proficiency is demonstrated.



As the role develops, additional responsibilities may include:



• Patient recall and follow-up outreach



• GeneSight and CNS Vital Signs testing logistics



• Spravato administrative coordination



• Credentialing and license-renewal tracking



• Payment-reconciliation support



• Website and provider-directory updates



• EHR migration support



• Additional practice-operations projects



SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday

7:00 AM–1:00 PM US Central Time



This is generally:



• 8:00 PM–2:00 AM Philippine Time during US daylight-saving time



• 9:00 PM–3:00 AM Philippine Time during US standard time



Applicants must be able to work the complete scheduled shift consistently.



Thirty hours per week are guaranteed. The assistant is expected to remain available and actively work throughout all scheduled coverage hours.



When patient volume is lower, scheduled time will be used for records processing, insurance follow-up, SOP development, audits, outreach, and other assigned administrative projects.



Up to 10 additional hours per week may be approved depending on workload. Additional hours may include flexible or asynchronous project work and must be authorized in advance.



Additional regular hours may become available as the practice grows.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• At least two years of experience supporting a US medical practice, healthcare organization, medical office, or US healthcare BPO account.



• Practical knowledge of US healthcare administration, health insurance, and HIPAA requirements.



• Hands-on experience using at least one US electronic health record system, such as Osmind, CharmHealth, Tebra/Kareo, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, or SimplePractice.



• Direct experience completing US insurance eligibility and benefit verification and/or prior authorizations.



• Experience communicating with US patients, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and medical offices.



• Excellent written and spoken English.



• Calm, courteous, and professional phone communication.



• Strong judgment regarding when an issue must be escalated.



• Exceptional attention to detail.



• Ability to follow written procedures consistently.



• Ability to work independently and manage recurring responsibilities without frequent reminders.



• Reliable availability for the stated schedule.



• Willingness to complete HIPAA, privacy, cybersecurity, and practice-specific training before receiving access to patient information.



• Willingness to sign all required confidentiality, privacy, security, and service agreements.



• Individual applicants only. Agencies, teams, subcontractors, and applicants planning to delegate the work will not be considered.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Osmind or CharmHealth experience



• Behavioral-health or psychiatric-practice experience



• Spravato or specialty-medication prior-authorization experience



• Experience with Availity or other payer portals and clearinghouses



• Experience following up on denied or unpaid medical claims



• Medical billing or coding education or certification



• Experience as the primary or sole administrative staff member of a small medical practice



• Experience creating standard operating procedures



• Experience supporting an EHR migration



• Familiarity with Spruce, Stripe, Jotform, Google Workspace, GeneSight, or CNS Vital Signs



• Nursing, pharmacy, medical-assisting, or allied-health education



WORKSTATION AND INFORMATION-SECURITY REQUIREMENTS



The selected applicant must have:



• A dedicated personal computer that is not shared with other users.



• A current and supported operating system with current antivirus and security protections.



• Full-disk encryption, automatic updates, and automatic screen locking.



• A separate password-protected computer profile used only for practice work.



• Primary internet service with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.



• A reliable backup internet connection.



• A backup power source sufficient for short power interruptions.



• A private, quiet workspace where patient information cannot be seen or overheard.



• A professional-quality headset.



• The ability to use multi-factor authentication and a practice-approved password manager.



Protected health information may be accessed only through practice-approved systems.



Patient information may not be downloaded, copied, printed, photographed, screen-recorded, stored locally, or transmitted through personal
, personal cloud storage, consumer messaging applications, or any unapproved system.



Screenshots containing patient information are prohibited. Any suspected privacy or security i
 must be reported immediately.



Screenshot-based time-monitoring software will not be used while the assistant is accessing patient or practice information.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• $7.00–$9.00 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience and demonstrated skill.



• Guaranteed minimum of 30 paid hours per week.



• Approximate guaranteed monthly base compensation of $910–$1,170 USD.



• Up to 10 additional approved hours per week based on workload.



• Payment twice monthly through Wise or another mutually approved method.



• Prorated 13th-month bonus during the first year.



• Annual performance-based increases generally ranging from $0.50–$1.00 USD per hour.



• Paid major US holidays after 90 days:



New Year’s Day

Memorial Day

Independence Day

Labor Day

Thanksgiving Day

Christmas Day



• Up to 30 hours of paid personal or sick leave annually after 90 days, subject to the written attendance and leave policy.



• Paid required training.



• Paid trial task for selected finalists.



• Opportunity for expanded responsibilities, additional hours, and advancement toward a Practice Coordinator role.



The first 90 days will be a mutual introductory and training period. Final terms will be documented in a written agreement.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete:



• A 1–2 minute voice recording



• A short written patient-communication scenario



• A typing and data-entry assessment



• A brief paid simulation using fictional or fully de-identified information



• A video interview



• Professional reference verification



• Identity verification



• A background check appropriate for a role involving protected health information, financial transactions, and access to medical-practice systems



No applicant will receive access to live patient information or practice systems before identity verification, required agreements, and privacy and security training are completed.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions exactly. Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. Write the word LIGHTHOUSE on the first line of your application.

2. Attach your current resume or CV.

3. Answer each question below in a separate numbered section:



A. Which US electronic health record systems have you personally used, and approximately how long did you use each one?



B. Describe your experience verifying US insurance eligibility and benefits. Which payers, portals, or clearinghouses have you used?



C. Describe your prior-authorization experience, including any specialty-medication, behavioral-health, or Spravato-related experience.



D. What types of US medical practices have you supported, and what were your primary responsibilities?



E. Without including patient-identifying information, describe one insurance verification, prior-authorization, or denied-claim issue you personally handled. Explain the problem, the steps you took, and the outcome.



F. Describe one workflow, checklist, tracker, or standard operating procedure that you created or improved.



G. State your expected hourly rate.



H. Confirm that you can consistently work Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM–1:00 PM US Central Time.



I. Confirm that you meet the computer, internet, backup-power, privacy, and security requirements listed in this posting.



J. Confirm that you are applying as an individual and will personally perform all assigned work.



All complete applications will be reviewed. Only applicants selected for the next stage will be contacted.

title: Finance Process & Controls Analyst
description:
The Finance Process & Controls Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of financial transactions across the Company's business systems. This role serves as the "exception detective" for Finance, proactively identifying failed transactions, process breakdowns, integration issues, and billing discrepancies before they impact customers, vendors, financial reporting, or cash flow.



The candidate possesses exceptional analytical skills, relentless attention to detail, and a passion for investigating complex problems. Rather than simply processing transactions, this individual will continuously improve business processes, identify automation opportunities, and partner with Finance, Operations, IT, and ERP teams to build scalable, highly reliable financial processes.



FLUENT ENGLISH - READING, SPEAKING, COMPREHENSION required

OBSESSIVE ATTENTION TO DETAIL





Key Responsibilities

Transaction Monitoring & Exception Management

Monitor daily financial transactions across NetSuite and integrated business systems.

Identify invoices, purchase orders, receipts, customer orders, vendor bills, inventory transactions, and journal entries that failed to process correctly.

title: PostAI Account Manager (Customer Success + AI Video, English)
description:
PostAI Account Manager — Done-for-You AI Video + Customer Success

Full-time | Remote (work from home) | GMT+8 friendly

Pay: 25% commission per video (~S$10–20 each, uncapped), with a guaranteed minimum of S$400/month.



ABOUT POSTAI

PostAI is an AI platform that lets anyone create professional marketing videos in minutes. The problem: many of our users WANT great videos but don't have the time to make them. That's where you come in.



As a PostAI Account Manager, you become a small business owner inside PostAI. We assign you customers; you create their videos by using PostAI platform, so our users are hands free and you grow your own book of clients. The more value you create, the more you earn — your income is uncapped.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

The work we pay you for — running demos, helping customers, and recording short demo clips — is ALSO how you grow your own income. Every demo you host and every clip you record can bring you new clients. You simply upload your clips to a shared folder; our system posts and distributes everything automatically and credits the leads to you. You never publish anything yourself. You're not just an employee — you're building a business with PostAI's tools, brand, and customer pipeline behind you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Understand each customer's needs, then make their video. Talk with your assigned customers to capture exactly what they want, then log into their PostAI account (via secure delegated access) and create the video. PostAI is click-based — no prompt-writing or technical skill needed. Most videos take about 20 minutes. Once in a while a small CapCut tweak is needed, to make a professional video

- Customer success and demos. Chat with your customers, answer questions, and run "over-the-shoulder" guidance over screen share. Host Zoom sessions teaching people how to use PostAI — attendees can hire you directly.

- Record demo clips (we auto-post them for you). Record your sessions and turn each into 3–5 short screen-demo videos (about 1 minute each; longer for a feature walk-through). Just upload them to a shared folder — our system posts and distributes everything automatically and routes inbound leads back to you.

- Own your customers. Keep them happy, responsive, and coming back. Retained customers mean recurring commission for you.

-You need take role as customer support / customer success manager, answer enquires and run demo/workshop, thats the way you build trust and get more potential clients (who hire you to create their videos)



COMPENSATION

- Commission: 25% of each video's value — roughly S$10–20 per video — with NO cap. Each video is quick (about 20 min), so strong managers earn well above the minimum.

- Guaranteed minimum: S$400/month. How it works: if your total commission for the month is below S$400, we pay you S$400; if it's above S$400, you keep the full amount. You're always paid whichever is higher.

- Example: at just 5 videos/day you're already earning multiples of the minimum; top performers do far more.

- 1-month onboarding period, then ongoing full-time.



WHAT WE EXPECT (minimum monthly)

- Full-time availability (about 40 hrs/week) and replies to your customers within 0.5 business hours.

- At least 20 delivered videos/month (scaled to the number of customers assigned to you — if we send you fewer, the target adjusts).

- From your sessions, produce 3–5 short screen-demo clips (about 1 min each) and upload them to the shared folder. Posting is automatic.

- Maintain quality and customer satisfaction (low redo rate, happy customers).



YOU MUST HAVE

- Excellent spoken and written English — this is the #1 skill. You'll be on demos and chatting with customers every day.

- Strong CapCut skills — you'll cut your session recordings into short demo clips, and make minor tweaks to customer videos.

- Comfortable on camera (Zoom demos and clips).

- A genuine customer-first attitude: patient, clear, friendly, reliable.

- Quick to learn software. PostAI itself is easy and click-based — no prompt-writing needed; we'll train you.

- A reliable computer and stable internet, available full-time.



NICE TO HAVE

- Familiar with AI tools — especially AI image generation and AI video generation. A big plus.

- Experience in customer support, virtual assistance, or SaaS.

- Experience making short-form content (TikTok / Reels / Shorts).

-
 PPC

- Cold call



HOW TO APPLY (follow all 4 steps — we ignore generic applications)

1. Start your message with "POSTAI-AM" so we know you read this.

2. Record a 60-second English video introducing yourself and explaining how you'd talk to a customer to find out what video they want — and how you'd help them.

3. Link 1–2 short videos you edited in CapCut.

4. Tell us your internet speed and your available hours (in GMT+8 / Singapore time).



We reply within a few days to applicants who complete all 4 steps.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
About Scriveiner

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





The Role

The Customer Success Specialist is the frontline of the customer experience at Scriveiner. When a customer writes to us  with a question, a problem, or a complaint you are the person who d
 whether that interaction reflects the standard we hold ourselves to.

This is not a ticket-clearing role. It is a resolution role. You will handle every enquiry with speed, care, and accuracy, follow through until the issue is genuinely closed, and contribute to a team culture where quality is reviewed openly every week. You will be coached day-to-day by the CS Team Leader for performance and development, and supported on product knowledge, escalations, and process by the Senior CS Specialist, who acts as the team's subject matter expert.

If you take pride in resolving things properly, not just answering quickly this role will suit you.





What You'll Own

Customer Ticket Handling & Resolution

Respond to all customer enquiries within 4 hours, ideally within 5 minutes during working hours

Read every customer's concern carefully and respond accurately and empathetically, following through until the issue is fully resolved

Tailor every reply to the specific customer and situation no generic or copy-paste responses

Document all ticket actions clearly so any tea
mber can pick up the case and follow the thread

Take ownership of customer issues never leave a case unresolved or half-answered



Adherence to Amazon Guidelines & Internal SOPs

Follow Amazon Community Guidelines strictly in all buyer communications no exceptions

Adhere to all internal Standard Operating Procedures maintained by the Senior CS Specialist

Escalate rather than guess when a situation is not covered by an existing SOP

Flag any SOP that appears outdated or incorrect to the CS Team Leader so it can be reviewed and updated

Treat compliance as non-negotiable issues identified in QA will be addressed in coaching with the CS Team Leader



Escalation Protocol

Escalate to the Senior CS Specialist when a case involves complex product or platform issues beyond standard resolution scope; FBM eligibility concerns, account health issues, or buyer disputes requiring senior judgement; situations where the correct process is unclear or not covered by an SOP; or any case where the wrong resolution could put the account at risk

Provide a clear summary of the issue, what has been done so far, and why you are escalating — never pass a ticket without context

Handle standard issues independently using the SOPs escalation is for genuinely complex cases, not for avoiding decisions



Review Generation

Contribute actively to the team's TOS-compliant positive review generation efforts

Ensure all review-related practices strictly follow Amazon's Terms of Service no exceptions

Check with the CS Team Leader or Senior CS Specialist before proceeding if unsure whether a practice is TOS-compliant



Weekly CS Tea
eting

Attendance and full participation in the weekly CS tea
eting are mandatory. Come prepared to:

Share one high and one low from the previous week, honestly

Walk through your tickets from the previous week the issue, how you handled it, and the outcome and expect probing questions

Share your QA findings with the team

Share any negative reviews linked to your handled cases, honestly and openly

State one specific, actionable focus for the coming week

Note the team takeaway and own any action items assigned to you







What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be successful when:

Response times are consistently within target customers hear from us fast, and hear something useful

Your tickets are resolved fully, first time, with clear documentation any teammate could follow

QA findings on your work are clean, and where coaching is needed, improvements stick

Escalations you raise are well-judged and well-framed and standard issues are handled independently

Review generation activity you contribute to is fully TOS-compliant

You show up prepared and engaged at every weekly tea
eting, and own your action items







Must Haves

Proven experience in a customer service or customer success role, ideally handling written buyer communications at volume

Excellent written English clear, warm, professional, and adaptable in tone. This is a working requirement, not a formality; every interaction is written, and quality of written communication is directly assessed

Demonstrated ability to work within defined SOPs and quality frameworks you follow process precisely, and you know when a situation falls outside it

Sound judgement on escalation: the discipline to handle standard cases independently, and the awareness to escalate genuinely complex ones with proper context

Full ownership mentality you close cases, document them properly, and own your action items without being chased

Comfortable with a QA-driven coaching culture: your work will be reviewed regularly, and coaching feedback is a normal part of the role

Reliable home working setup stable internet, quiet environment, and the discipline to maintain consistent response times during working hours







Strongly Preferred

Hands-on experience with Amazon buyer messaging or marketplace customer service, and familiarity with Amazon Community Guidelines and Terms of Service

Familiarity with helpdesk or ticketing systems, and comfort working within structured queues, tagging conventions, and resolution workflows

Experience in a premium or quality-focused brand environment, where the standard of communication matters as much as the speed of response

Prior involvement in TOS-compliant review generation or customer feedback programmes

Experience working in a small, high-ownership team where accountability is visible and standards are openly discussed





HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the form here:

title: Founding SEO Strategist
description:
# Founding SEO Strategist



**Remote · Full-time · $2,000 to $3,000/mo to start, with a clear path up**



---



## Read this part first



Most SEO job posts are written by people who can't tell a good SEO from a bad one. This one isn't. I run the campaigns myself, I've built the systems, and I know exactly what "good" looks like, so I'm going to be direct about who I want.



I want someone cracked. Someone who ranks sites in their sleep, treats a stalled campaign as a puzzle instead of a reason to
 me asking what to do, and has real opinions about SEO earned from testing things, not from watching YouTube.



If that's you, keep reading. If it's not, no hard feelings.



## Who we are



We're an established SEO agency helping local businesses, mostly home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, cleaning, window cleaning), and a handful of e-commerce brands rank at the top of Google. US-based, US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, proven processes, and results that keep clients coming back. We're growing fast, and now we want to go from strong to exceptional. That's where you come in.



## The role



This is our **founding SEO strategist** seat. You're the first dedicated SEO hire stepping into a machine that already works, not a mess you have to clean up. The systems are built and they produce. Your job is to take them further: run them at a high level, own delivery for our clients, and make the systems themselves genuinely stronger so our results go from great to exceptional.



You'll build advanced strategy alongside me. I want someone who knows the real levers and the order to pull them in, not someone who runs a 40-point checklist because a course told them to. I know that the primary category move is worth more than the next hundred citations. I know review velocity beats review count. I know most of what agencies sell is hygiene dressed up as growth. You should know that too, in your bones, from having tested it.



A big part of this is AI, and I mean both sides of it: automating our own grunt work so we deliver faster, and owning the shift to AI search before our clients even know it's happening. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



## What you'll own



- Owning SEO delivery across our client campaigns, start to finish

- Google Business Profile as the primary battleground: category strategy, proximity and service-area logic, and the engagement signals that actually hold a map-pack position once you win it

- Verifying and defending profiles across multiple clients: passing video verification, working suspensions back to live with proper documentation, and knowing the DBA/business-registry angle when a straight appeal stalls

- Review systems that run themselves: building velocity without tripping Google's filter, and recovering legitimate reviews that got filtered or wrongly removed instead of shrugging and chasing new ones

- Taking our existing SOPs and making the
asurably stronger, then documenting what you changed and why

- Automating the boring parts with AI (Claude, APIs, whatever gets it done) so neither of us does the same manual task twice

- On-page and technical: canonicalization, schema, internal link equity flow, site structure that a page-2 result can climb out of

- Link building with judgment. Manufacturer and certification directories, real editorial placements, natural anchor profiles. You know why a pile of high-DR links with no topical relevance does nothing, and you know what an over-optimized anchor profile looks like before Google does

- Citation building and ordering as a hygiene floor, not a monthly deliverable we pretend is moving the needle

- Getting new pages and links **indexed** (we run paid indexers, not GSC "please crawl this" prayers), and knowing not to submit a URL before the destination content is actually live

- Keyword and competitor research that produces a decision, not a spreadsheet nobody opens

- GEO / AI search: llms.txt, FAQ and question-based structure, entity and schema work, and tracking where our clients surface across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok. Roughly a third of LLM-cited pages have zero organic presence, and I want someone who already understands why that's an opportunity

- Blog strategy and content scheduling that feeds both classic ranking and AI citation

- Analytics and reporting (GA4, GSC, GTM, plus AI-referral tracking) turned into the next three moves, not a chart that goes up



## Who you are



- **Native-level English.** You'll talk to me constantly and sometimes to clients. Non-negotiable.

- **An over-communicator.** This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. If you go quiet, this doesn't work. The best people on my team tell me what's happening before I have to ask.

- **A problem-solver with no ego.** A stalled campaign is a puzzle, not a reason to
 me asking what to do. You hit a wall, you research it, you test your way out, then you tell me what you learned. I leave my ego at the door and I want the same from you.

- **Fluent across the whole spectrum.** White hat, grey hat, and enough understanding of black hat to know exactly where the line is and why we don't drag client assets across it. I don't want a cowboy who torches a client's profile chasing a shortcut. I want someone who knows PBNs, parasite SEO, expired-domain plays, CTR and engagement manipulation, and DBA/name strategy well enough to recognize them in a competitor's profile and d
, deliberately, what's worth it and what isn't.

- **Always sharpening.** The day you think you know everything about SEO is the day you stopped testing.



## What you've actually done



- **Ranked multiple local businesses** into the map pack and held them there. Not "worked on." Ranked. You can walk me through a campaign where you knew the lever, pulled it, and watched the position move. Local is our bread and butter; e-commerce is a strong bonus.

- **Tested your own strategies on your own properties.** White hat, grey hat, whatever taught you something. I want someone who's broken a site, understood why, and rebuilt it smarter. Cookie-cutter operators need not apply.

- **AI-fluent and automation-first.** You automate instead of grinding. Comfortable with Claude, wiring up APIs, and spinning up full site builds fast. If a process can run itself, you build it once instead of doing it by hand forever.

- **Verified and reinstated GBPs the hard way.** You've passed video verification, you've fought a suspended profile back to live with real documentation, and you've won back reviews that got filtered or removed. Anyone can swap a category. Recovering a suspended profile is where I find out whether you actually know the platform.

- **Understand what actually holds a ranking:** engagement signals, dwell time, click behavior, the conversion actions Google reads through Chrome. You know that winning position one and keeping it are two different games.

- **Expert in the core tools:** Semrush, Ahrefs, GSC, GA4, GTM. Bonus if you've lived in BrightLocal, indexers, and any of the AI-visibility trackers and claude code.

- **Worked on a team before.** You know how to hand off, document, and collaborate.



*(Quick one so I know you actually read this: what's your favorite vegetable, and why? Put the answer at the very top of your application.)*



## What I offer



- **Growth that's real.** As we add clients, the role grows and your pay grows with it. $2,000/mo to start, scaling toward $3,000+ as you take on more ownership, and higher over time as we grow together.

- **A real path to managing.** You're the founding SEO hire. As the team grows, the right person becomes the one who runs it.

- **Real ownership.** No bureaucracy, no ten layers of approval. You own SEO here and you'll feel it.



## Logistics



- **Full-time, remote.**

- **Overlap with US business hours.** I need at least [X] hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time so we can collaborate in real time. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours.

- Start date: ASAP



## How to apply



Send me the following, and yes, I read every single one:



1. Your favorite vegetable and why (from above)

2. Your name and age

3. **What motivates you, be brutally honest.** "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one. I trust honest people more than polished ones.

4. The coolest thing you've ever done with SEO



Apply here:

 support, light photo editing, social media support, and Executive Assistant-style tasks.

 marketing systems, landing pages, automations, or backend business setup would be highly valued. This is not required at the beginning, but it would be a strong bonus.

* Monitoring incoming text and
 inquiries during agreed hours

s

 sequences, forms, automations, products, offers, and simple website updates

This is a regulated product category. Any text or claims placed on images must be approved by us first. Accuracy matters more than creative freedom on wording. Do not add performance claims (e.g., "cures," "best," "guarantees").

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Note: Please only apply if you meet requirements and can follow the step for applying. 



We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed and CURRENT introduction video from YOU not CHATGPT that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Content Strategist
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist to own content strategy and direction across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a strategy and direction role, not a full-execution role. You will set the plan, build the systems, and write the direction — a separate Social Media Manager will handle daily scheduling, publishing, and day-to-day content production from your direction.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income. Our business includes low-ticket offers and live challenges, webinars and launch campaigns, a membership, and a flagship course.



We are a systems-driven team with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards. We move fast, especially during launch periods.



What This Role Actually Is



This role sits at the intersection of content strategy and conversion strategy. You are the strategic brain behind what gets made and why — not the person filming, editing, scheduling, or posting it day to day.



We are looking for someone who understands how to use content to:





Grow the right audience

Build trust and authority

Support active offers

Convert attention into leads and sales

Build a repeatable content system a Social Media Manager can execute consistently





What We Are Looking For



1) You have a real content strategy framework



You have a repeatable process for auditing a brand, its audience, and its offers; identifying what content should drive reach vs. trust vs. conversion; building content pillars and campaign-specific plans; turning strategy into hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs; and reviewing performance to adjust course.



We want someone who can clearly explain how they build a content strategy that drives business results — not vague "I help brands show up consistently" language.



2) You have proof that your work has driven both growth and revenue



You should be able to show accounts you've worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, what changed after your strategy was implemented, and how your content supported lead generation, launches, or sales. Views and followers alone are not enough — we care about business impact.



3) You understand short vertical video deeply



Strong working knowledge of TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, and
 content strategy. You understand that content cannot simply be reposted everywhere without thought — each platform needs its own strategic lens inside one cohesive brand system.



4) You can direct execution, even if you're not the one publishing it



You will write hooks, scripts, captions, and CTA direction, and hand it to a Social Media Manager to produce and post. You should be comfortable giving clear, specific creative direction rather than vague notes — the SMM will follow your lead closely, so precision matters.



5) You are highly organized and proactive



You meet deadlines without being chased, communicate proactively, and are comfortable collaborating with a founder who is also a strategist.



What This Role Involves





Deep-diving into the brand: audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors

Developing content strategy based on where the brand is going, not just what's been posted before

Delivering weekly content direction for Instagram, LinkedIn,
, and TikTok

Writing hooks, script direction, captions, and CTAs tied to active offers

Building and maintaining a content system: competitor tracking, hook libraries, campaign content planning, content direction frameworks

Reviewing performance data and adjusting strategy each cycle

Joining bi-weekly strategy calls

Directing the Social Media Manager's execution during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns





Not part of this role: daily scheduling, publishing, or manual content production. That sits with the Social Media Manager, working from your direction.



You Are the Right Fit If…





You have a documented, repeatable process for content strategy

You can show at least 2 examples of accounts you helped grow and monetize

You understand the difference between content for audience growth, authority/trust, and sales

You know how to support a business with multiple offers and live launches

You can write precise creative direction that someone else can execute from

You communicate clearly and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable with deadlines, structure, and accountability





This Is Not the Right Role If…





You are still learning social media strategy and building your process as you go

Your experience is mostly posting support or content coordination without measurable strategy results

You cannot clearly explain how your content strategy has supported sales or conversions

You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown

You need to personally film, edit, or publish every piece of content yourself

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or organized systems





How to Apply





A brief breakdown of your content strategy framework — how you approach a new brand from day one, how you d
 what content is for growth vs. trust vs. conversion, how you build strategy across Instagram,
, and TikTok, how you measure whether content is working.



Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize — brand/account, platform(s), performance before you got involved, strategy implemented, what changed, any lead/sales/revenue results connected to your work.





Applications that are vague, generic, or do not include proof of results will not be reviewed.

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases.



2) You have a real feel for short vertical video



You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll — even if you're not the one setting the overall strategy. You can take a script or direction and execute it well, not just literally.



3) You're proactive, not just responsive



You flag what's underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction. You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I'm going to change the plan."



4) You're highly organized and communicative



You meet deadlines without being chased, you don't go quiet when things get busy, and you're comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes rather than building your own from scratch.



5) You're comfortable working under direction from a Content Strategist



This role reports into content direction set by someone else. You should want that structure, not resent it — the win here is doing excellent work inside a clear system, not owning the strategic vision yourself.



What This Role Involves





Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok from the Strategist's direction

Managing and maintaining the content calendar

Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting and delivery

Monitoring performance day to day and flagging what's working or not

Keeping content organized in our shared systems (Google Workspace, ManyChat, Metricool)

Adapting quickly and staying responsive during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns

Communicating proactively — daily check-ins during active periods





You Are the Right Fit If…





You have real experience executing content at volume across multiple platforms

You understand short vertical video and can execute strong hooks, pacing, and text overlays from direction

You are highly organized and reliable with deadlines

You communicate proactively and don't disappear when things get busy

You're comfortable executing someone else's strategic direction while still bringing your own instincts to the work





This Is Not the Right Role If…





You want to set the overall content strategy yourself

You need full creative ownership over every decision

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or structured systems

You're only comfortable posting content, without any instinct for what's actually working





How to Apply





A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you've used.

One or two examples of accounts where you handled execution — what your role was specifically, and what the results looked like.

Your availability for a full-time role.





Applications that are vague or don't include specifics on your actual execution experience will not be reviewed.

title: Event Admin Coordinator
description:
Virtual Events Admin

Remote - Full Time



About Your Startup Operations



We're Your Startup Operations, a boutique agency providing operational services to small businesses. 



About the Role



We're hiring for a Virtual Events Admin to join the YSO team. If you love the energy of the events world and want to help us build something from the ground up (not just execute someone else's playbook), this is for you. No two days look the same here, and you'll have real ownership over how this role takes shape.



Our Score Values



Solution-focused: Think critically and propose solutions independently.

Curiosity: Ask questions and actively seek understanding.

Ownership: Take full accountability and responsibility for your role.

Resourcefulness: Use all available resources to solve challenges or answer questions.

Excellence: Deliver high-quality work and exceptional results.



Who You Are



You have a strong administrative foundation: calendar and inbox management, document organization, contracts, proposals, quotes, and invoices — and you follow through without being chased.

You've coordinated logistics with vendors, venues, contractors, or third-party partners and can manage moving pieces across multiple stakeholders.

You walk into ambiguous situations and create structure. You are proactive and detail-obsessed — you see what needs to happen and move on it before you're asked.

You are warm, professional, and client-ready, since you'll be repping YSO directly. You own your mistakes, fix them fast, and think in solutions rather than problems.

Hint: On your first interview, mention which SCORE value you most align with at the end of the interview for huge bonus points.



Role Requirements



- Minimum of 1 year experience in event coordination, event administration, or event operations, end-to-end, not just day-of execution.

- 2+ years working with clients based in the US, UK, Canada, or Australia.

- Must speak and write fluent English

- Proficiency with CRM platforms and event management tools; ability to learn new systems quickly.

- Bonus points if you have experience in catering, desserts, alcohol, or food service events.

- Reliable internet connection with a backup; ability to work scheduled remote hours consistently. (Minimum: Download Speed +20 MB / Upload Speed 5 MB)

- A Computer:

At least 8GB of RAM and an Intel Core 8th generation processor or higher, or AMD Ryzen 2000 series or higher.

Operating system: Windows 11 or higher / macOS 13 or higher

Working camera and microphone



Responsibilities



- Drive the full event pipeline for our own clients: handle incoming inquiries, prepare quotes and proposals, send contracts, issue invoices, and manage follow-ups.

- Be the primary point of contact for clients throughout the event cycle, representing YSO directly.

- Coordinate with vendors, venues, contractors, and our internal team to confirm logistics, timelines, and deliverables.

- Build and maintain detailed event timelines and run-of-show documents so every stakeholder knows exactly what's happening and when.

- Manage and keep our CRM up-to-date: leads, pipelines, client records, follow-up reminders, and event status.

- Track inventory, supplies, and equipment needed per event. Stay ahead of what's required so nothing is missing day-of.

- Manage inbox, scheduling, meeting notes, and day-to-day administrative tasks that keep our operation running smoothly.

- Support business development during slower seasons: lead sourcing, outreach, and light marketing coordination as needed.



Desired but not required:

- Background in a specific event vertical: weddings, corporate, AV/production, food & beverage, or similar.

- Experience building internal systems and SOPs from scratch in a growing business.





Benefits



Effective immediately:

7 paid company holidays

Company social events & game nights

Bi-monthly team training



After 3 months:

1 local holiday choice per year

$100/year professional development allowance

One-time $50 workspace reimbursement

10 days PTO / 3 sick days per year



After 1 year:

Healthcare reimbursement up to $50/month (eligible expenses)

An additional one-time $50 workspace reimbursement

Possible year-end bonus (company discretion)

title: Supply Chain & Project Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 
/share/base/form/shrlg5pFuw8LjdqeGFOVZLD9i0d



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in USA and Singapore. Our supply chain span across 4 countries, 10+ suppliers and 3 warehouses. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino tea
mbers and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain & Project Manager to support the Head of Supply Chain in executing Crafti's day-to-day operations - supplier coordination, production tracking and inventory management.



This role requires someone who is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. Supply chain runs around the clock. Our suppliers operate across time zones, and updates can come at any hour. This is not a typical Monday to Friday, clock-in clock-out job.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Enjoy speaking with suppliers to ensure that they are able to deliver items on time

- Can process high volumes of information from multiple channels simultaneously and translate them into clear next actions, without needing someone to connect the dots

- Like to push projects forward and move things along rather than wait to be told what's next

- Enjoy keeping detailed records and staying organised



Do not apply if:



- Your supply chain experience is limited to admin support without direct supplier contact

- You are uncomfortable learning and using new software tools and AI independently

- You are not comfortable working outside standard hours when suppliers or shipments require it

- Your written English is not business-professional level



What You'll Do



- Supplier Communication & Coordination — monitor all communication channels daily and respond to supplier and team updates with urgency. Chase production status updates from 10+ suppliers at the same time



- Inventory Allocation — manage production splits across sales channels



- Production Tracking — update production records in our tracking database with same-day accuracy. Coordinate manufacturing schedules, flag any production delays or risks to the team proactively.



- Purchase Order & Manufacturing Order Management — create and track POs and MOs in MRPeasy.



- QC Process Management — prepare QC quote requests with QC checklists attached, coordinate QC inspections and review defect documentation



- Shipping Coordination — prepare transfer requests and coordinate with the logistics team to ensure products move from production to warehouses in Singapore and the US on schedule.



- Inventory Reporting — prepare monthly inventory reports, action low-stock items, and complete month-end reconciliation



What We Are Looking For:



Skills:



- 2+ years in supply chain, operations, or logistics at a product company

- Experience managing active supplier relationships

- Responsive and comfortable across multiple communication platforms simultaneously (WhatsApp,
, Wechat)

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with Tech tools and AI



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- High urgency and ownership - today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done no matter what

- Proactive Communicator - if I foresee something may be wrong, I will highlight as soon as possible

- Adaptable - I embrace new tools, new processes and AI; and I want to keep improving

- Has Opinions - I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 70,000 – 130,000 per month (based on experience)



Commitment: Full-time, Philippine business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm PHT) with flexibility for supplier updates outside standard hours)
